pages.text: A Salvegleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a pink-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When held and toggled on, the gem will heal you for half a heart approximately once every second if you are hurt. Each half heart consumes a point of charge.
To recharge a dun Salvegleam, slaughter a passive animal while holding the gem. Doing so restores points of charge equal to half of the animal's maximum health.

$(bold)Gemcutter recipe$()$(br2)1 × arcanearchives:shaped_quartz$(br)4 × minecraft:pink_dye$(br)1 × minecraft:golden_apple$(br)1 × minecraft:glistering_melon_slice$(br)1 × minecraft:golden_carrot$(br2)Output: 1 × arcanearchives:salvegleam
